<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $filter, $location, spUtil, $window) {
  var c = this;

  c.data.selectedSwap = null;
  c.data.swapDetails = null;
  c.data.isLoadingDetails = false;
  c.data.isCancelling = false;
  c.data.isUploadingAttachment = false; // Tracking UI Attachment Upload State
  
  // OOB Widget Tracking
  c.data.ticketWidget = null;
  c.data.attachmentWidget = null; 
  c.data.isLoadingWidget = false;
  
  c.searchSwap = ''; 
  c.listFilter = 'all';

  // Pagination Config
  c.currentPage = 1;
  c.itemsPerPage = 10;

  // INR Formatting Utility Engine
  c.formatINR = function(val) {
      if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '0.00';
      var num = parseFloat(val);
      if (isNaN(num)) return '0.00';
      return num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  // URL Parameter Deep Linking
  var initUrlNumber = $location.search().number;
  if (initUrlNumber) {
      c.server.update().then(function() {
          var targetSwap = c.data.list.find(function(s) { return s.number === initUrlNumber; });
          if (targetSwap) {
              c.viewDetails(targetSwap);
          }
      });
  }

  c.setFilter = function(filterType) { 
    c.listFilter = filterType; 
    c.currentPage = 1; 
  };

  c.getFilteredSwaps = function() {
    var arr = c.data.list || [];
    if (c.listFilter === 'pending') {
      arr = arr.filter(function(b) { return b.internalState === 'pending' || b.internalState === 'work'; });
    } else if (c.listFilter === 'completed') {
      arr = arr.filter(function(b) { return b.internalState === 'approved' || b.internalState === 'rejected' || b.internalState === 'cancelled'; });
    }
    return $filter('filter')(arr, c.searchSwap);
  };

  c.getPaginatedSwaps = function() {
    var filtered = c.getFilteredSwaps();
    var startIndex = (c.currentPage - 1) * c.itemsPerPage;
    return filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + c.itemsPerPage);
  };

  c.totalPages = function() {
    return Math.ceil(c.getFilteredSwaps().length / c.itemsPerPage) || 1;
  };

  c.getMathMin = function(a, b) {
    return Math.min(a, b);
  };

  // View Drill-down
  c.viewDetails = function(swap) {
    c.data.selectedSwap = swap;
    c.data.isLoadingDetails = true;
    c.data.ticketWidget = null;
    c.data.attachmentWidget = null; // Clear prev states
    
    // Update the URL natively without reloading page
    $location.search('number', swap.number);
    
    // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - Send request to Server Script for specific Swap details
    c.server.get({
      action: 'get_swap_details',
      swapSysId: swap.sys_id
    }).then(function(response) {
      // HIGHLIGHT: BINDING - Applying the returned mapped Geo Data and Metrics back to the Frontend View
      c.data.swapDetails = {
        approvals: response.data.approvalData,
        extended: response.data.extendedDetails
      };
      c.data.isLoadingDetails = false;
      
      c.data.isLoadingWidget = true;

      // 1. Inject Native OOB Ticket Attachments Widget
      spUtil.get('ticket-attachments', {
          sys_id: swap.sys_id,
          table: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request'
      }).then(function(attWidget) {
          c.data.attachmentWidget = attWidget;

          // 2. Inject Native OOB Ticket Conversation Widget
          spUtil.get('widget-ticket-conversation', {
              sys_id: swap.sys_id,
              table: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request', 
              btnLabel: 'Post Reply'
          }).then(function(convoWidget) {
              c.data.ticketWidget = convoWidget;
              c.data.isLoadingWidget = false;
          });
      });

    });
  };

  // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - New Functionality to Process File Uploads natively for Ticket Activity
  c.attachFileToStream = function(inputElement) {
      if (!inputElement.files || inputElement.files.length === 0) return;
      var file = inputElement.files[0];
      
      c.data.isUploadingAttachment = true;
      $scope.$applyAsync(); // Force Angular Digest for UI Spinner

      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(e) {
          var base64Data = e.target.result.split(',')[1];
          
          c.server.get({
              action: 'upload_attachment',
              swapSysId: c.data.selectedSwap.sys_id,
              fileName: file.name,
              contentType: file.type,
              fileData: base64Data
          }).then(function(response) {
              c.data.isUploadingAttachment = false;
              if (response.data.success) {
                  spUtil.addInfoMessage("File '"+ file.name +"' securely attached to the request.");
                  // Re-trigger the Drilldown to natively refresh both Conversation and Attachment widgets
                  c.viewDetails(c.data.selectedSwap); 
              } else {
                  spUtil.addErrorMessage("System Error: Unable to upload attachment securely.");
              }
          });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  // Cancel Swap Request
  c.cancelRequest = function(swap) {
      if(confirm("Are you sure you want to cancel this Limit Swap request? This action will permanently halt all backend workflows.")) {
          c.data.isCancelling = true;
          
          c.server.get({
              action: 'cancel_swap',
              swapSysId: swap.sys_id
          }).then(function(response) {
              c.data.isCancelling = false;
              if (response.data.success) {
                  spUtil.addInfoMessage("Swap Request " + swap.number + " has been successfully cancelled.");
                  c.goBack();
                  c.server.update(); // Refresh grid
              } else {
                  spUtil.addErrorMessage("Error: Unable to cancel the request.");
              }
          });
      }
  };

  c.goBack = function() {
    c.data.selectedSwap = null;
    c.data.swapDetails = null;
    c.data.ticketWidget = null;
    c.data.attachmentWidget = null;
    $location.search('number', null);
  };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* Premium Enterprise Container Styling */

    // Global Segment Mapping Enforcer
    var segmentMapping = { 'UTCL': 'Cement', 'URMX': 'RMC', 'GIL': 'BPD' };

    function getInternalState(stateStr) {
        var s = (stateStr || '').toLowerCase();
        if (s.indexOf('pending') > -1 || s.indexOf('requested') > -1) return 'pending';
        if (s.indexOf('approved') > -1 || s.indexOf('complete') > -1 || s.indexOf('3') > -1) return 'approved';
        if (s.indexOf('reject') > -1 || s.indexOf('4') > -1) return 'rejected';
        if (s.indexOf('cancel') > -1) return 'cancelled';
        return 'work';
    }

    // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - New Helper to fetch Geography as Name(Code) dynamically for Drilldown
    function getFormattedGeo(gr, nameField, codeField) {
        var name = gr.getValue(nameField) || '';
        var code = gr.getValue(codeField) || '';
        if (name && code) return name + ' (' + code + ')';
        if (name) return name;
        if (code) return code;
        return 'N/A';
    }

    // HIGHLIGHT: GET VALUE - New Helper to fetch Geography as Name(Code) dynamically for Master List referencing
    function formatRefGeo(grRecord, nameField, codeField) {
        var name = grRecord.getElement(nameField).toString() || '';
        var code = grRecord.getElement(codeField).toString() || '';
        if (name && code) return name + ' (' + code + ')';
        if (name) return name;
        if (code) return code;
        return 'N/A';
    }

    // --- 1. DRILL-DOWN CLICKS ACTION ---
    if (input && input.action == 'get_swap_details') {

        // A. Approvers & Role Extraction
        data.approvalData = [];
        var grApp = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        var qc = grApp.addQuery('sysapproval', input.swapSysId);
        qc.addOrCondition('document_id', input.swapSysId);

        grApp.query();

        while(grApp.next()) {
            var customRole = grApp.getValue('u_role') || grApp.getValue('u_approval_level') || grApp.getValue('approval_journal_column') || 'Approver';
            if (customRole && customRole.length > 25) { customRole = 'Approver'; } 
            
            data.approvalData.push({
                approver: grApp.getDisplayValue('approver'),
                state:    grApp.getDisplayValue('state'),
                role:     customRole,
                updated:  grApp.getValue('sys_updated_on') || ''
            });
        }

        // B. Enriched Un-Squished Site Profile Metrics Lookups
        data.extendedDetails = {};
        var swapGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_nt_limit_swap_request');
        
        if (swapGr.get(input.swapSysId)) {

            var doneeId = swapGr.getValue('donee_site_code'); 
            var donorId = swapGr.getValue('donor_site_code'); 

            // Explicit function mapping the detailed hierarchies & bucket aging
            function getCustDetails(sysId) {
                // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Initializing variables without City mapping
                var details = { name: 'N/A', code: 'N/A', zone: 'N/A', region: 'N/A', depot: 'N/A', segment: 'N/A', limit: 0, outstanding: 0, history: [] };
                
                var cGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');
                if (cGr.get(sysId)) {
                    details.name    = cGr.getValue('name') || 'N/A';
                    details.code    = cGr.getValue('customer_code') || 'N/A';
                    
                    // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Binding the constructed Name(Code) fields
                    details.zone    = getFormattedGeo(cGr, 'zone_name', 'customer_group');
                    details.region  = getFormattedGeo(cGr, 'region_name', 'cg4'); 
                    details.depot   = getFormattedGeo(cGr, 'depot_name', 'sales_office');
                    
                    var compCode    = cGr.getValue('company_code') || '';
                    details.segment = segmentMapping[compCode] || cGr.getDisplayValue('company_code') || 'N/A';
                    details.limit   = parseFloat(cGr.getValue('credit_limit') || 0);

                    // Fetch associated 6-month outstanding exposure array
                    var outRec = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer_outstanding');
                    outRec.addQuery('customer', details.code);
                    outRec.orderByDesc('created_on');
                    outRec.setLimit(6);
                    outRec.query();
                    
                    var isFirst = true;
                    while (outRec.next()) {
                        var outVal = parseFloat(outRec.getValue('outstanding') || 0);
                        if (isFirst) {
                            details.outstanding = outVal;
                            isFirst = false;
                        }
                        
                        var rawDate = outRec.getDisplayValue('created_on') || '';
                        details.history.push({
                            date:   rawDate.split(' ')[0], 
                            total:  outVal,
                            a0_3:   parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing0_3') || 0),
                            a4_7:   parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing4_7') || 0),
                            a8_21:  parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing8_21') || 0),
                            a22_30: parseFloat(outRec.getValue('ageing22_30') || 0),

    if (!input) {

            var donorName = swapGR.donor_site_code.name || swapGR.getDisplayValue('donor_site_code') || '';
            var donorCombined = donorCode ? (donorCode + ' — ' + donorName) : donorName;

            var rawDonorSeg = swapGR.getValue('donor_segment') || swapGR.donor_site_code.company_code || '';

            var fDoneeZone   = formatRefGeo(swapGR, 'donee_site_code.zone_name', 'donee_site_code.customer_group');
            var fDoneeRegion = formatRefGeo(swapGR, 'donee_site_code.region_name', 'donee_site_code.cg4');
            var fDoneeDepot  = formatRefGeo(swapGR, 'donee_site_code.depot_name', 'donee_site_code.sales_office');

            var fDonorZone   = formatRefGeo(swapGR, 'donor_site_code.zone_name', 'donor_site_code.customer_group');
            var fDonorRegion = formatRefGeo(swapGR, 'donor_site_code.region_name', 'donor_site_code.cg4');
            var fDonorDepot  = formatRefGeo(swapGR, 'donor_site_code.depot_name', 'donor_site_code.sales_office');

            // HIGHLIGHT: SET VALUE - Pushing cleaned payload to the client side
            data.list.push({
                sys_id:             swapGR.getUniqueValue(),
                number:             swapGR.getValue('number') || '',
                pan:                swapGR.getDisplayValue('donee_site_code.pan') || swapGR.getDisplayValue('donor_site_code.pan') || 'N/A',

            });
        }
